item.title: Re: SCP IN FINLAND??
item.content:encoded:
Oh hey, a fellow Finn.

There are a few SCPs that are in Finland or mention Finland (torille), like SCP-4947, SCP-2719 and SCP-2541. (Plus those two -J articles that mention the Finland conspiracy which stopped being funny two years ago, if it ever even was.)

But yeah, there's no containment site in Finland. Yet.

item.title: Re: SCP IN FINLAND??
item.content:encoded:
is there a branch of the foundation in finland

We don't have an official translation site for Finnish. If you're asking about in-universe, then probably? The Foundation is a global organization.

and if not can we do it?

Yes. Just write up an SCP, tale, or GoI format page that introduces your Finland site. We don't add new sites to the list of facilities unless they already have some successful works written that mention them.
